criterion: which type of event the trigger word stated at the end of the text ("The event trigger is ...") denotes

categories.name: Role or Title
categories.definition: Denotes a specific job, position, or designation held by an individual or group.

categories.name: Award or Recognition
categories.definition: Denotes an honor, prize, or successful achievement.

categories.name: Relationship Event or Status
categories.definition: Denotes a personal connection, formal union, or an event related to such a connection.

categories.name: Commercial Transaction
categories.definition: Denotes an exchange of goods, services, or money.

categories.name: Conflict or Violence
categories.definition: Denotes an act of aggression, dispute, or destructive physical event.

categories.name: Movement or Location
categories.definition: Denotes an act of changing position, being situated in a place, or a specific place itself.

categories.name: Communication or Publication
categories.definition: Denotes the act of conveying information, ideas, or messages, or the resulting output.

categories.name: Employment Action
categories.definition: Denotes an action related to the hiring, termination, or performance of work.

categories.name: Legal or Political Action
categories.definition: Denotes an action or situation related to law, justice, or governance.

categories.name: Creative Output or Performance
categories.definition: Denotes an artistic production, composition, intellectual work, or its public presentation.

categories.name: Organizational Entity
categories.definition: Denotes a formal group, body, or system established for a particular purpose.

categories.name: Status or Affiliation
categories.definition: Denotes a state of belonging, occupancy, or participation in a group or place.

categories.name: Educational Process or Achievement
categories.definition: Denotes an action, process, or qualification related to learning or academic pursuits.

categories.name: Medical Event
categories.definition: Denotes an event related to health or medical treatment.

categories.name: General Activity
categories.definition: Denotes a broad action, process, or condition not covered by more specific categories.
